image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of two bowls containing Asian-style shaved ice desserts. The bowl on the left contains dark purple/black tapioca pearls (boba) and a block of white condensed milk or tofu pudding in a clear syrup. The bowl on the right features scoops of yellowish ice cream or sorbet, dusted with cinnamon or cocoa powder, alongside other toppings like peanuts or beans. A bunch of yellow bananas is visible in the blurred background.
